summary: Show every SLO target's live 1-minute, 5-minute and 1-hour windows on the request-latency read and in st doctor, from slo/targets.toml

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change; the windows are process memory only and are never written to the graph.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: GET /v1/client/request-latency keeps its routes array and adds targets and paths. st doctor adds slo/ lines; a missed target is info, never warn or fail, so doctor --strict and its exit status are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Normal restart on deploy; the windows start empty after each restart.

manual.detail: Nothing to configure; the targets file is built into the daemon.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build drops only the in-memory windows and the added fields.
